svg.title: DRISHTI system architecture
svg.text: Browser → Zoho Catalyst trusted edge → Catalyst operational services, with a protected server-to-server analytical plane. No browser ever holds a database credential.
React 18.3 + TypeScript SPA · 39 role-scoped routes · SPA redirects
Derives role + scope SERVER-SIDE · strips 9 spoofable identity headers and every
x-drishti-* header · mints a 60-second HMAC-SHA256 signed context (aud
FastAPI 0.115 on python:3.12-slim, custom OCI, port 9000, 512 MB, 1 pinned instance
· 37 routers / 391 endpoints · VERIFIES signature, audience, scope, expiry and
nonce replay before any non-health request
106 idempotent import configs + 20 native tables (6 board, 14 hazard)
3 private versioned buckets; 900 s pre-signed exact-object URLs
idempotency, rate limit, nonce, lookup · layouts, presence
no-code workload baseline · RAG over 6 approved SOP sources
10 jobs / 6 stages: validate → build → security → preflight → deploy → smoke
HMAC over ts|nonce|body · rate limiter · circuit breaker · audit
140 tables · 3,011,145 rows · 1.02 GB · HNSW cosine ANN
Digital evidence objects and model artifacts
TabFM · TimesFM 2.5-200M · ST-GNN — fails closed off CUDA
Ask DRISHTI semantic planner behind the signed adapter
Duplex voice transport only; answers stay in Zoho
HTTPS + HMAC over ts|nonce|body — no AWS keys on AppSail
Written transactionally with the action; sensitive keys stripped
Version, feature snapshot, backtest, human review
Role × 9 scope types · jurisdiction · rate · payload
drishti_readonly role, read-only txn, deny-lists, row cap
Boot refuses a non-synthetic database marker
Public config only. A release build FAILS on a Postgres URL,
PEM key, AKIA id or any amazonaws.com URL in dist/.
Client identity headers stripped, then a signed 60 s context
injected. Unsigned requests get an opaque 401.
Only the backend reaches PostgreSQL, private object storage or
GPU inference. The browser has no path to AWS.
No model may dispatch, accuse, arrest, close a case or modify
a protected record. Human review is mandatory.

Verified 6 Sep 2026: Slate HTTP 200 · API Gateway /api/health 200 (database true, postgis/vector/pg_trgm/pgrouting present) · AppSail /health/ready 200 ready=true, environment synthetic_hackathon. All records are synthetic demonstration data.
